description: This file defines classes and functions related to CUDA graph capturing and replay in PyTorch, including the CUDAGraph class, graph context manager, and utility functions for graph handling and graphed callables.

classes.name: CUDAGraph
classes.description: Wrapper around a CUDA graph, providing methods to capture, instantiate, replay, and manage CUDA graphs.

classes.name: graph
classes.description: Context manager that captures CUDA work into a CUDAGraph object for later replay.

methods.name: is_current_stream_capturing
methods.description: Returns True if CUDA graph capture is underway on the current CUDA stream.

methods.name: graph_pool_handle
methods.description: Returns an opaque token representing the id of a graph memory pool.

methods.name: CUDAGraph.capture_begin
methods.description: Begins capturing CUDA work on the current stream.

methods.name: CUDAGraph.capture_end
methods.description: Ends CUDA graph capture on the current stream.

methods.name: CUDAGraph.instantiate
methods.description: Instantiate the CUDA graph for execution.

methods.name: CUDAGraph.reset
methods.description: Delete the current graph held by the instance.

methods.name: CUDAGraph.pool
methods.description: Return an opaque token representing the graph's memory pool.

methods.name: CUDAGraph.enable_debug_mode
methods.description: Enable debugging mode for the CUDA graph.

methods.name: CUDAGraph.debug_dump
methods.description: Dump the CUDA graph to a specified path for debugging.

methods.name: graph
methods.description: Context manager that captures CUDA work into a CUDAGraph object for later replay.

methods.name: make_graphed_callables
methods.description: Accepts callables and returns graphed versions for optimized CUDA execution within autograd.
